mapper.sql: SELECT w.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TT."pageNo") AS "rownum_", TT.*, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY "pageNo") AS "totalCount" FROM ( SELECT ROW_.* , ${rnTop} / (${rnTop} - ${rnBottom} ) AS "pageNo", ${rnTop} - ${rnBottom} AS "pageSize" FROM (

select (ROW_NUMBER() OVER()) AS "rownum", a.point_sq as "pointSq", -- 장비 Sq a.site_sq as "siteSq", a.site_nm0 as "siteNm0", --지자체 a.site_nm1 as "siteNm1", --사업소 a.site_nm2 as "siteNm2", --구 a.site_nm as "siteNm", --사이트 이름 (동) a.blk_sq as "blkSq", -- 블럭 Sq a.set_years as "setYears", --수용가 대상년도 a.cust_sq as "custSq", -- 수용가 Sq a.use_cd as "useCd", -- 사용코드 (0:점검, 1:사용중, 7:사용중지) case a.use_cd when '1' then '검침중' when '7' then '검침중지' end "useCdStr", a.check_day as "checkDay", --검침일 a.admin_id as "adminId", -- 검침관리코드 a.cust_nm as "custNm", -- 수용가 이름 a.addr_old as "addrOld", -- 구주소 a.addr_new as "addrNew", -- 도로명주소 a.meter_no as "meterNo", -- 미터번호 a.use_type as "useType", -- 업종 (가정용/일반용/학교용) a.pipe_dia as "pipeDia", -- 관경 a.blk_name1 as "blkNm1", -- 상위 블럭이름 a.blk_name2 as "blkNm2", -- 중블럭이름 a.blk_name as "blkNm", -- 하위 블럭이름 a.read_opr as "readOpr", -- 검침원 a.check_day as "chkDay", --검침일 a.cust_phone as "custPhone", --전화번호 a.loc_lng as "locLng", -- 위도 a.loc_lat as "locLat", -- 경도 a.set_dt as "setDt", -- ami 설치일 to_char(a.set_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as "setDtStr", a.p_remark as "pointRemark", -- 비고 a.ins_dt as "insDt", -- 등록일시 a.upd_dt as "updDt", -- 수정일시, b.meas_dt as "measDt", to_char(b.meas_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi') as "measDtStr", trunc(b.accu_iv) as "accuIv", b.adjst_os as "adjstV", b.stat_cd as "statCd", case position('1' in b.stat_cd) when 1 then '통신 장애' when 2 then '계량기 장애' when 3 then 'Q3 초과' when 4 then '역류' when 5 then '누수' when 6 then '정상' when 7 then '정상' when 8 then 'BAT' else '정상' end "statCdStr", a.ami_type as "amiType", a.dev_no as "devNo", a.sub_dev_no as "subDevNo", b.raw_cnt_0d as "rawCnt_0d", b.term_cv_0d as "termCv_0d", b.raw_cnt_1d as "rawCnt_1d", b.term_cv_1d as "termCv_1d", b.raw_cnt_7d as "rawCnt_7d", b.term_cv_7d as "termCv_7d", b.raw_cnt_30d as "rawCnt_30d", b.term_cv_30d as "termCv_30d", b.delay_rcv as "delayRcv", b.bat2_iv as "bat2Iv",
case when b.bat2_stat = '1' then '장애' when b.bat2_stat = '0' then '정상' end "bat2Stat",
a.company_sq as "comSq", a.company_nm as "comNm", a.company_cd as "comCd",
c.meas_dt as "leakMeasDt", to_char(c.meas_dt, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi') as "leakMeasDtStr", c.waterleak_flag as "leakFg",
a.inform_cd as "informCd",
a.send_cd as "sendCd", a.send_dt as "sendDt", b.temperature, a.img_src_gum, a.img_src_bf, a.img_src_af, a.img_src_add from vi_m1_sv_point_list a left outer join vi_m1_sv_meas_now b on b.POINT_SQ = a.POINT_SQ left outer join tb_m1_meas_waterleak c on c.point_sq = a.point_sq
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.ami_err_code, m.meas_dt as lr_meas_dt FROM client_meas_raw m WHERE m.point_sq = a.point_sq AND m.meas_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - 3 ORDER BY m.meas_dt DESC LIMIT 1 ) lr_f ON TRUE
where 1=1
and a.site_sq in ( select site_sq from fn_prj_sites(#{upSiteSq}::integer, #{lv}::integer) )
and a.site_sq = #{upSiteSq}::integer
and a.use_cd = '1'
and (lr_f.lr_meas_dt IS NULL OR lr_f.lr_meas_dt < CURRENT_DATE - 3)
and lr_f.lr_meas_dt IS NOT NULL and lr_f.lr_meas_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - 3 and substring(lr_f.ami_err_code, 1, 1) = '1'
and lr_f.lr_meas_dt IS NOT NULL and lr_f.lr_meas_dt >= CURRENT_DATE - 3 and (lr_f.ami_err_code IS NULL OR substring(lr_f.ami_err_code, 1, 1) != '1')
